verdict.rationale: Tavily exposes search, extract, crawl, and map behind one API and SDK. Its Research endpoint runs multiple searches, analyzes sources, and generates a detailed report, with mini/pro depth modes, async retrieval by request ID, and streaming. Agents can reach these tools via SDK, CLI, or the official MCP server, and one community user reports having agents use Tavily for deep-research-style work. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the Research endpoint's synthesis quality, and documentation of how sources and citations appear in synthesized reports.
